correctness.rationale: The proof reduces every positive continuant of fixed total weight to a sequence of coordinate-sum steps from the initial pair. Greedy retention of the larger coordinate gives the Fibonacci upper bound. In the parity-obstructed residue class, the first non-greedy step has a Fibonacci-product loss, and the stated Fibonacci product identity yields the sharp correction. Explicit positive rational diagrams attain each case. Substitution into the published quadratic estimate is direct. Exhaustive composition checks through crossing number eighteen independently sanity-check the formula but are not the proof.

value.rationale: The exact determinant extremum converts a new presentation-theoretic bound from dependence on the Schubert numerator into a uniform crossing-number theorem for the entire two-bridge class. It improves the exponential base of the available general crossing bound from eight to the square of the golden ratio, approximately 2.618, and the residue-class correction is structurally forced by knot-versus-link parity of Fibonacci numerators rather than being an arbitrary finite slice.
